answer: Counterparty-diversity bond: each identity posts 70 credits and must trade with 12 distinct partners across three island clusters. A jade ledger lists each edge; a sable seal marks each trade. Self-trading rings fail the island test; bonds burn. The k-th fake pays 38+7(k-1) for outside trades: 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Borrowed edges bear the lender's seal and burn both bonds. An honest agent pays 38 once.
